title: VirtualCrime: Evaluating Criminal Potential of Large Language Models via Sandbox Simulation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It was designed to evaluate the criminal potential of Large Language Models in a sandbox simulation environment, focusing on tasks like theft, robbery, kidnapping, and riot.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings focus on the criminal capabilities of LLMs, revealing that some models achieve high success rates in simulated crimes, sometimes inflicting harm on NPCs, and that general model capability does not reliably correlate with higher criminal success rates.
